low.assessment: The three questions are correct and progressive, but they stay close to the same recurrence expansion. A future redesign could require an explicit return-stack/intermediate-state judgment rather than another subtotal.

Questions 2 and 3 both ask for final aggregates after the same full scan. They test different variables and remain valid, but one could later be replaced by a branch-sensitive intermediate-state checkpoint for greater trace depth.

The separate 40-item final algorithm pool still carries the v204 Low fidelity watch: compact independent items dominate, so a future final-practice fidelity phase should add a small number of denser contexts/state presentations without expanding features for their own sake.

decision.next_scope: Subject B final-practice fidelity and context/state density audit
decision.goal: Preserve the 20=16+4 exam contract and breadth controls while checking whether the 40 final algorithm items provide enough dense, multi-stage state tracing to approximate exam pressure.
